purpose: The lifecycle contract, written once and executed twice. tests/lifecycle.test.ts runs these through the server classifier; tests/lifecycle-parity.test.ts runs the same rows through the web client's mirror. A rule that lives in one implementation and not the other cannot survive both files.

cases.name: an operator archive outranks a fresh, live session
cases.claim: Human intent beats every machine fact. The contradiction is disclosed on the row, not silently overturned.

expect.reason: Archived by operator.

cases.name: an operator archive outranks a recorded session exit
cases.claim: Both say finished; the operator's reason is the one a human recognises.

expect.reason: Archived by operator.

cases.name: an operator archive outranks a confirmed dead process
cases.claim: Row order, not evidence strength, decides which reason gets published.

expect.reason: Archived by operator.

cases.name: a newer lane session retires its predecessor
cases.claim: A manifest replacement is an observed lane ending even when the predecessor process is still alive.

expect.reason: Replaced by a newer session for this lane.

cases.name: a recorded session exit outranks the clock
cases.claim: A source that says the session is over is believed even one second after it wrote.

expect.reason: Source recorded a session exit.

cases.name: a recorded session exit outranks a process that is still up
cases.claim: The harness can linger after the session closes; the row discloses the contradiction rather than reopening the session.

expect.reason: Source recorded a session exit.

cases.name: a recorded session exit finishes a long-quiet session with no process evidence
cases.claim: This is the one quiet+unavailable case that IS an ending, because something recorded one.

expect.reason: Source recorded a session exit.

cases.name: an ended hook is a recorded provider exit
cases.claim: The cmux hook store saying the session ended is the same fact as a provider exit, even while a harness process is still up.

expect.reason: Source recorded a session exit.

cases.name: fresh transcript writes outrank a dead-process probe
cases.claim: Probes lie more often than a file being written to right now does — codex renamed to codex-next cost this board a wave of false deaths.

expect.reason: Fresh transcript writes outrank a stale process probe.

cases.name: a dead process ends a session that is no longer fresh
cases.claim: Checked, by id, and gone. This is evidence, so it is allowed to finish a session.

expect.reason: Process checked and gone; nothing ended cleanly.

cases.name: a dead process ends a long-quiet session
cases.claim: The same verdict past the quiet threshold, so silence is never what did the finishing.

expect.reason: Process checked and gone; nothing ended cleanly.

cases.name: a gone process in a deleted worktree retires without retained process ids
cases.claim: A pid-less negative probe is not death on its own; the missing cwd is the corroboration that lets retirement fire.

expect.reason: Process checked and gone after its worktree was deleted.

cases.name: explicit worktree-deleted endEvidence finishes the session
cases.claim: Collectors may pre-synthesize the retirement fact; the classifier must honour it the same way it honours session-exit.

expect.reason: Process checked and gone after its worktree was deleted.

cases.name: a missing cwd alone does not retire a fresh session
cases.claim: A deleted checkout without a gone-process probe is not an ending — the row stays working on recency.

expect.reason: Source activity within the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: a negative probe against an existing cwd does not retire without process ids
cases.claim: processAlive:false with a living worktree and no retained pids is unanswered, not retired — fresh activity still wins.

expect.reason: Source activity within the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: a negative liveness answer with no process ids is not death
cases.claim: processAlive:false without the ids it was about is an unanswered question, not a gone process.

expect.reason: No activity in 5h and no process evidence — could not verify an ending.

cases.name: a turn that finished moments ago is a wait, not an ending
cases.claim: Claude end_turn and Codex task_complete are the agent yielding the floor.

expect.reason: Turn finished — waiting on you.

cases.name: fresh activity with nothing else recorded is working
cases.claim: The plain case, and the reason names the threshold that produced it.

expect.reason: Source activity within the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: fresh activity with a live process is working
cases.claim: A live process adds nothing the clock has not already said.

expect.reason: Source activity within the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: an age below zero is clamped rather than believed
cases.claim: Clock skew between a file mtime and the scan produces negative ages; a session cannot be working in the future or old because of it.

expect.reason: Source activity within the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: silence inside the quiet threshold is waiting
cases.claim: The mid band: quiet enough to stop working, not quiet enough to doubt.

expect.reason: No source activity in the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: a turn-complete session in the mid band keeps the turn's reason
cases.claim: Same lifecycle as plain recency, different provenance — the stall detector reads this to know whose move it is.

expect.reason: Turn finished — waiting on you.

cases.name: a live process in the mid band is still waiting
cases.claim: The mid band does not consult the process table; it does not need to.

expect.reason: No source activity in the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: a live process is never finished by silence
cases.claim: Three hours quiet with a process that answers is waiting, and the row says how long it has been.

expect.reason: Quiet 3h · process live.

cases.name: a completed turn does not demote a process that is still alive
cases.claim: Row 8 outranks row 9: evidence of life beats absence of a reply.

expect.reason: Quiet 3h · process live.

cases.name: a turn that finished hours ago with nothing to check is unverified
cases.claim: Filing this as Waiting would put ~105 sessions nobody is waiting on into every stall alarm and burn denominator.

expect.reason: Turn finished 2h ago; no reply and no process evidence.

cases.name: long silence with no process evidence is unverified, never finished
cases.claim: The core of the contract: absence of evidence is not evidence of an ending.

expect.reason: No activity in 5h and no process evidence — could not verify an ending.

cases.name: a probe that failed this scan reads as unavailable, not as death
cases.claim: A collector or probe outage leaves processAlive undefined. The evidence gap surfaces through source health; it never demotes a lifecycle.

expect.reason: No activity in 2d and no process evidence — could not verify an ending.

cases.name: the working band closes at the freshness threshold, not later
cases.claim: One millisecond under the threshold is still working.

expect.reason: Source activity within the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: the freshness threshold itself is already waiting
cases.claim: Bands are closed-open: at exactly F the session has left the working band.

expect.reason: No source activity in the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: the waiting band closes at the quiet threshold, not later
cases.claim: One millisecond under the quiet threshold is still waiting.

expect.reason: No source activity in the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: the quiet threshold itself is already unverified
cases.claim: At exactly Q with nothing to check, the board stops claiming to know.

expect.reason: No activity in 45m and no process evidence — could not verify an ending.

cases.name: a retained record keeps the provider exit it was filed with
cases.claim: archiveCopy strips process evidence, so a record out of the scan window carries its verdict instead of being re-derived from nothing.

expect.reason: Source recorded a session exit.

cases.name: a retained record keeps the operator archive it was filed with
cases.claim: Provider exit and operator archive stay permanently distinguishable in History.

expect.reason: Archived by operator.

cases.name: a retained operator archive outranks later succession evidence
cases.claim: A newer lane binding cannot rewrite a human filing decision after the archive has custody.

expect.reason: Archived by operator.

cases.name: a session that left the scan window while waiting is aged out, not ended
cases.claim: The fourth reason a row is in History: nobody ended it, the board simply stopped watching.

expect.reason: Left the scan window without an ending — no longer watched.

cases.name: a session that left the scan window while unverified stays unverified
cases.claim: Custody does not upgrade a verdict into an ending it never had.

expect.reason: Left the scan window without an ending — no longer watched.

cases.name: a legacy record with no persisted verdict reads as aged out
cases.claim: Records written before this contract existed still load, and say the one true thing about themselves.

expect.reason: Left the scan window without an ending — no longer watched.

cases.name: custody freezes the verdict even when the surviving fields look alive
cases.claim: Retained records re-enter the merge every refresh for thirty days; re-deriving them would resurrect a fleet out of the filing cabinet.

expect.reason: Left the scan window without an ending — no longer watched.

cases.name: an observed session is classified from evidence, not frozen
cases.claim: The other side of the custody rule: a persisted verdict is ignored while the session is still being watched.

expect.reason: Source activity within the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: a complete scan that claims nothing ends a quiet session
cases.claim: A scan that RAN and matched nothing is an observation. Only a scan that could not run is a gap — that split is what stopped 200 of 245 sessions sitting permanently in unverified.

expect.reason: Quiet 5h and no running process claims this session.

cases.name: a complete scan never ends a session that is still writing
cases.claim: Roster absence is read only in the quiet band. A session our attribution heuristics miss keeps writing its transcript, so recency answers first and it stays working.

expect.reason: Source activity within the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: a complete scan never ends a session inside the recent band
cases.claim: Same protection one band out: a session quiet for ten minutes is still waiting on a human, not finished, however empty the roster is.

expect.reason: No source activity in the last 3 minutes.

cases.name: a completed turn plus an empty roster is an ending, not an aged turn
cases.claim: Roster absence outranks turn-complete-aged: knowing nothing runs it is strictly more than knowing it stopped replying.

expect.reason: Quiet 5h and no running process claims this session.

cases.name: a live process outranks the roster that failed to name it
cases.claim: Direct evidence of running beats an enumeration that did not attribute it. Order matters: alive is checked before absent.

expect.reason: Quiet 5h · process live.

cases.name: known pids that are gone still read as died, not merely absent
cases.claim: Evidence about THIS session outranks an argument from the roster, and History says which one the board actually witnessed.

expect.reason: Process checked and gone; nothing ended cleanly.

cases.name: a scan that could not run still cannot end anything
cases.claim: The whole contract in one case. Without a completed enumeration the board is back to knowing nothing, and says so.

expect.reason: No activity in 5h and no process evidence — could not verify an ending.
